verdict.rationale: Omarchy's Install menu offers a curated set of apps/dev environments (docs-2, docs-15), and community evidence confirms it sits atop Arch's package mirrors and enables AUR-like third-party repos (comm-3, comm-8), which together give access to a vast software ecosystem. However, this isn't a distinct 'official Omarchy catalog' of thousands of apps — it's the underlying Arch/AUR system, and community reports flag it as a risky 'free for all' with supply-chain concerns (comm-8, comm-18). Missing for 10: an official Omarchy-branded catalog listing (not just menu shortcuts to a few dozen apps), documentation of catalog size/scope, and independent confirmation that thousands of apps are installable without falling back to raw pacman/AUR commands.
